card.name: Prepositions before signs to watch for
card.fires_on: The small word 'for' or 'of' right after 'remain alert' or 'evidence' in warnings, just before a list of signs and symptoms to watch for.

modes.label: Remain alert for
modes.description: The word 'for' after 'remain alert' in NSAID GI-bleeding warnings.
modes.example: Remain alert<< for>> signs and symptoms of GI ulceration and

modes.label: Evidence of
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'evaluated for evidence' in liver warnings.
modes.example: should be evaluated for evidence<< of>> the development of a more severe hepatic

card.writes: The suppressed words (available, accessible, sufficient) suggest it pushes away availability-type words after the linking word; the promoted tokens show no clear pattern.
card.plain: It marks the little word that comes right before a list of warning signs to watch for.
